concept: CloudTrail: auditing API calls (who and when)
tests: Which service records every API call in the account with the caller's identity and time.
expected: AWS CloudTrail — a log of API activity: who, from where, when. Triggers: "all API calls recorded", "identity", "compliance/security analysis".
why_not: CloudWatch — metrics and logs; AWS Config — resource configuration change history; Inspector — vulnerability assessment.
